data.title: Alleged Indian leader of neo-Nazi child abuse ring goes on trial in Paris
data.description: PARIS — An Indian man went on trial in Paris on Monday, accused of running a neo-Nazi child exploitation ring in which young girls were allegedly coerced into performing sexual acts online and engaging in self-harm.

data.title: Two dead, 11 rescued after fire onboard ship in Black Sea
data.description: BUCHAREST - Romanian authorities said on ​Monday that two people ‌had died and others had been rescued after a fire on a ship in the Black Sea outside Romania's territorial waters.

data.title: Slovenian glacier, tracked since 1946, could disappear within days
data.description: MOUNT ​TRIGLAV — Once a magnet for ​summer skiers and cherished by generations as a ​symbol of Slovenia's Alpine heritage, ‌one of the country's last glaciers has dwindled to a few patches of ice that researchers say could disappear within days.

data.title: Hundreds of French high schools shut as protests persist
data.description: PARIS — Lessons were suspended at hundreds of French high schools on Monday, as part of a wave of student protest over learning conditions that have rocked the European nation.

data.title: Spain PM calls early election after housing crisis defeat
data.description: MADRID - Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on Monday called a snap election for November 29, after parliament rejected housing relief measures proposed by his minority government.

data.title: US arrests woman accused of spying for China on Taiwan leader's family
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - A woman accused of spying for China on Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te's son and his family in the United States was arrested Sunday, US and Taiwanese officials said.

data.title: Yemen military announces broad strikes against Houthis
data.description: TAIZ (YEMEN) - The Yemeni military announced a broad set of strikes against Houthi targets on Monday, after the government declared a new campaign to retake all territory even as the Iran-backed group made fresh gains on the ground.

data.title: Myanmar says 10,000 migrants returned from Malaysia this year
data.description: YANGON (MYANMAR) - Myanmar has repatriated nearly 10,000 migrants from Malaysia this year, state media said on Monday, a day after a flotilla returning almost 1,500 of its citizens docked in the country.

data.title: About 360 people tow Pokemon aircraft at Narita airport
data.description: About 360 children and adults joined forces to tow a roughly 133-tonne Boeing 787 aircraft decorated with Pokemon characters at Narita airport near Tokyo, moving it about 80 metres in an event to spur interest in aviation.

data.title: Three years on, Israeli rescuer cannot escape October 7
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israeli rescuer Natan Kenig says it does not take much of a trigger for him to relive the October 7, 2023 attack: his eyes open or closed, at home or out with friends, he still sees the rockets, torched cars and lifeless bodies.

data.title: EU, China to hold Beijing talks to avert trade war
data.description: BRUSSELS - EU trade chief Maros Sefcovic will head to Beijing on Thursday for two days of make-or-break meetings with Chinese officials to try to stave off a trade war.

data.title: Research into weight-loss drugs tipped for Nobel as award week opens
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Research into hormones that regulate appetite is on everybody's lips for the Nobel medicine prize, to be announced on Monday when the 2026 Nobel season kicks off.

data.title: Rubio visits Iceland as US boosts Arctic presence
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel Monday to Iceland to continue pressing US interests in the Arctic, two weeks after Washington sealed a security pact on Greenland.

data.title: Bosnian Serb strongman claims election win, thanks Trump and Putin
data.description: SARAJEVO - The former president of Bosnia's Serb statelet, Milorad Dodik, said his party had retained power in the entity and its seat on the shared presidency, as preliminary results showed a drop in turnout for Bosnia's general elections.

data.title: Indians protest election chief ahead of top court hearing
data.description: NEW DELHI - Indian opposition activists rallied for a third day on Sunday to demand the election commission chief's resignation, alleging wrongdoing during a large-scale revision of voter rolls in the world's largest democracy.

data.title: Up to 500 French schools to be totally or partly closed Monday: minister
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Up to 500 schools across France will be totally or partly closed on Monday because of a wave of student protests that has shaken the country, the education minister said.

data.title: Trump confirms national intelligence chief as new AI czar
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump on Sunday confirmed national intelligence chief Jay Clayton as head of a new White House task force on artificial intelligence, amid increasingly vocal warnings from researchers about the technology's potential dangers.

data.title: Iran tells US there is no military solution to Middle East war
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran's top diplomat insisted on Sunday that there would be no military solution to the United States' war against the Islamic republic, with talks on ending the conflict apparently at an impasse.

data.title: UK Green party adopts 'Zionism is racism' policy
data.description: LONDON - The UK's left-wing Green party on Sunday voted to define Zionism as racism at the party's annual get-together, drawing sharp backlash from British Jewish groups and the Israeli government.

data.title: Ethiopia controls Tigray capital as regional rivals meet in Egypt
data.description: ADDIS ABABA - Ethiopian federal forces were in full control of the Tigray rebels' regional capital, a local journalist said Sunday, while Ethiopia's regional rivals gathered in Egypt to discuss the risk of a wider war.

data.title: Russia strikes hit Kyiv as Germany's Merz visits
data.description: KYIV - Russia struck a bridge in Kyiv on Sunday soon after Germany's chancellor arrived in Ukraine's capital on a surprise visit to demonstrate European support in the face of an upsurge in attacks.

data.title: Cry for help as French-Swiss lake dries up
data.description: LES BRENETS (SWITZERLAND) - The picturesque Lac des Brenets between France and Switzerland has dried up after a record-breaking hot summer, leaving locals crying out for help to save the lake.

data.title: Cornell president vows review in wake of alleged student gang rape
data.description: NEW YORK - The president of Cornell University voiced support Saturday for an external review of the institution facing widespread outcry over the alleged gang rape of a student in 2024.

data.title: Forum host Tuvalu at frontline of climate change
data.description: NADI, Fiji - When leaders visit the coral atolls that form the Pacific nation of Tuvalu on Tuesday, they will find a once-vibrant ecosystem wiped out due to climate change.

data.title: Brazil votes in nail-biter polls closely watched by Trump
data.description: BRASíLIA - Brazilians vote Sunday in a toss-up race between President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro that will decide whether Latin America's biggest nation follows a regional swing to the right championed by US President Donald Trump.

data.title: Myanmar migrants sent back to war-torn nation from Malaysia
data.description: THANLYIN, Myanmar - Nearly 1,500 Myanmar migrants sent back from Malaysia arrived in their war-torn home country on Sunday, a Myanmar naval official said, returned under an opaque repatriation scheme.

data.title: South Korean flag glitch sees Asian Games end on sour note
data.description: TOYOTA CITY, Japan - South Korea's Asian Games football captain called it "disappointing" after the country's flag appeared to get stuck during the victory ceremony following their win over hosts Japan.

data.title: Israel targets top Hamas leader in deadly Gaza strike on anniversary
data.description: GAZA CITY (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Israel said on Saturday that it attempted to kill Hamas's top leader in the Gaza Strip in an airstrike on an apartment that local officials said killed five people, four of them women.

data.title: Houthis say Saudi Arabia launches dozens of strikes on Yemen capital
data.description: SANAA - Yemen's Houthis accused Saudi Arabia of launching dozens of strikes on Sanaa on Saturday, while an AFP journalist in Riyadh reported seeing flames and smoke coming from an oil facility on the outskirts of the Saudi capital.

data.title: UAE: flydubai co-pilot was planning ‘terrorist act’
data.description: DUBAI - Investigators in the United Arab Emirates have said the co-pilot of a flydubai flight to Israel this week was planning a “terrorist act” and used the cockpit’s emergency axe to attack the captain, but they did not reveal his motive.

data.title: Russia warns diplomats to leave Kyiv before ‘massive’ strikes
data.description: KYIV - Russia on Saturday issued a new call for diplomats and foreigners to leave Kyiv, warning the Ukrainian capital of new “massive” air attacks hours after striking another major bridge in the city.

data.title: Bulgarian tsar returns ‘home’ after 1,000 years
data.description: SOFIA, Bulgaria - More than 1,000 years after his death, the remains of what may be Tsar Samuel, one of the last major rulers of the First Bulgarian Empire, are returning “home” on Saturday.

data.title: Philippines voices concern over Myanmar airstrike deaths
data.description: MANILA - ⁠The ⁠Philippines has expressed concern over ​an airstrike in ‌Myanmar that caused about 50 civilian deaths, saying it stands ready as the Asean chair to facilitate discussions on how the bloc can best pursue peace in Myanmar.
